Effects.Empty: No effects. Click a status above, or drop an effect on the sheet.
Effects.RulesMissing: This status's rules page couldn't be found in the LOTM Rules compendium.

Toggle.TooltipOn: {name} is on. Click to switch it off.
Toggle.TooltipOff: {name} is off. Click to switch it on.
Toggle.TooltipOffCost: {name} is off. Click to switch it on ({cost} Spirituality).
Toggle.TooltipUpkeep: Keeping it on costs {upkeep} Spirituality per round in combat.
Toggle.RanOut: {name} doesn't have the Spirituality to keep up {effect}, so it ends.

Apply.Passive: {name} is passive: it applies to the item's owner by itself.
Apply.NoCaster: Who's using {name}? Select your token, or open the item from a character.
Apply.NoTargets: Target the tokens that get {name} first.
Apply.NoGM: {name} belongs to someone else, and no GM is logged in to apply the effect.
Apply.GMFailed: The GM's client couldn't apply the effect to {name}.
Apply.Gone: That item or its effect no longer exists.
Apply.NotOwner: Only {name}'s owners and the GM can apply this.

Area.PlaceHint: Place {name}: left-click to place, mouse wheel to turn, right-click to cancel.
Area.ChooseIntro: Everyone inside the area. Untick anyone who shouldn't get it.
Area.NoCasterToken: {name} has no token on this scene to center the emanation on.

Granted.CopiedFrom: Copied from the ability {name}: edit the ability instead
Granted.Notice: Some effects from granted abilities are out of date or missing.

Zone.MarkerDetail: Zone on the scene: remove this to end it

Item.ApplyHint: Apply: hand it out the way its LotM tab says (targets, self, ...)
Item.Empty: No effects. Click New Effect, or drop one here from the Effects compendium.
Item.Hint: Passive effects apply to the owner by themselves. The others are handed out with Apply, the Apply button on the attack card, or by dragging them onto a token.

Config.SourceHint: Who the effect is about: the source of Fear or Anger, the enemy Advantage is over. Filled in when it's applied.
Config.FromTargetHint: Set the source to the token you have targeted
Config.TargetOne: Target exactly one token to make it the source.
Config.UpkeepHint: Spent at the start of each of the owner's turns in combat while it's on. Not enough: it switches off. 0 = free to keep up. The action's Spirituality Cost is still paid to switch it on.
Config.UseHint: Passive: applies to whoever owns the item. Targets: your targeted tokens. Self: you. Area: everyone in a shape you place, once. Zone: everyone inside a shape that stays on the scene. Toggle: you, until you use it again (an On / Off button on the action).

effects.label: Effects
effects.hint: Tokens inside get a copy of each, and lose it when they leave. Drop effects here from the Effects compendium or an item.

source.label: Source
source.hint: The actor the copies are about (the caster), for Fear's or Advantage's source. Leave it empty for a zone you made by hand.

includeSource.label: Affects its source too
includeSource.hint: Normally the source isn't affected by its own zone.

Traits.Label: Traits
Traits.Hint: Statuses check these before it's used: Silence stops speech, Off Guard stops reactions, Bound stops grapples and parries, Blind stops anything aimed.

Chat.Recovered: {name} is no longer Semi-Out-of-Control. (Any mythical changes to the body fade after 5 minutes of rest; longer hair and nails stay.)
Chat.OverflowEnded: {name}'s spiritual overflow settles: the new abilities work normally.

TurnStart.Title: Start of {name}'s turn
TurnStart.Gone: That status is no longer on the creature.
TurnStart.NotOwner: Only the creature's owner or the GM can roll this.
TurnStart.AlreadyUsed: That has already been rolled this turn.
TurnStart.BleedingNoLoss: {name} bleeds, but loses no Health (physical improvement).
TurnStart.InternalBleeding: Internal bleeding: only extraordinary medicine or surgery stops it.
TurnStart.Bloodbath: Physique check (DC {dc}), or {name} faints and is Helpless.
TurnStart.Dying: Physique check (DC {dc}), or {name} dies. This round: up to 3 free actions and 1 quick action; a Will check (DC {actDc}) turns them into 1 attack, casting or move action, at half movement.
TurnStart.DyingImproved: {name} is dying, but acts normally (physical improvement).
TurnStart.Fear: Every movement action can only go away from {source}. Will check (DC {dc}) to resist.
TurnStart.Angry: {name} must attack or chase {source} first. Will check (DC {dc}) to calm down.
TurnStart.Shock: {name} loses 1 attack, casting or move action, or 2 quick actions, this turn.
TurnStart.SemiOutOfControl: {name} writhes on the ground (no move actions). Will check (DC {dc}), or a 0/1 sanity check. Madness tendency: {tendency}. {rounds}

Results.CanAct: {name} can take 1 attack, casting or move action this round, at half movement.
Results.CannotAct: {name} can't take an attack, casting or move action this round.
Results.Resisted: {name} resists the fear: no more forced movement. Checks against {source} are still -4.
Results.MeditatedHalf: {name} meditates: the anger's penalty is halved.
Results.NotResisted: {name} doesn't resist the fear after all: forced movement again.
Results.MadnessSymptom: {name}'s madness takes hold: {symptom}. Act it out until the next symptom roll.

Restrictions.Title: Use {name}?
Restrictions.lossOfBalance: Loss of Balance: can't take movement actions. Standing up takes 1 movement action.
Restrictions.bound: Bound: can't take movement actions (squirming at Agility speed is the GM's call), and can't parry or grapple.
Restrictions.silence: Silence: can't use language-related actions and abilities.
Restrictions.blind: Blind: an action aimed at something needs an Inspiration check (DC 15) first, or it can't be taken.
Restrictions.dying: Dying: only free and quick actions, unless a Will check (DC {dc}) turns them into 1 attack, casting or move action.
Restrictions.semiOutOfControl: Semi-Out-of-Control: writhing on the ground, no movement actions.
Restrictions.outOfControl: Out of Control: the character is lost; the GM takes over.

Notes.TargetBound: {name} is Bound: Vital Strike isn't at a disadvantage.
Notes.TargetInvisible: {name} is Invisible: a Spot or Listen check against its Stealth finds it first, otherwise it can't be attacked (areas of effect still work).
Notes.Blind: Blind: Inspiration check (DC 15) first, or the action can't be taken. Usually no critical strikes.
Notes.Deaf: Deaf: hearing checks fail (halved instead for extraordinary hearing, unless the deafness is extraordinary too).
Notes.SemiOutOfControl: Semi-Out-of-Control: using a Beyonder ability means a 1/1d2 sanity check.

SkillCheck.Title: Skill Check
SkillCheck.OverrideHint: Rolling with a different attribute than this skill's default. This applies to this roll only.
SkillCheck.UntrainedBlocked: {skill} is untrained, and the GM has disabled untrained skill checks.
SkillCheck.InvalidActionFormula: The roll formula on {action} ("{formula}") isn't valid, so 1d20 was rolled.
SkillCheck.InvalidActionFormulaHint: This action's roll formula isn't valid, so 1d20 will be rolled instead:

RollDialog.ShiftHint: Tip: Shift-click a roll to skip this window.

GrantedSkills.GrantsSkillsHint: Characters with this ability get a skill tab for it, where they can add skills from the options below or custom ones.
GrantedSkills.AnalyzeSkillsHint: Characters can analyze their other non-Education skills; each analyzed skill is added to this ability's tab as an Education skill.
GrantedSkills.AnalysisHint: Beyonder abilities analyzed toward this skill. The GM decides when they earn a level.
GrantedSkills.Empty: No skills yet. Add one below.
GrantedSkills.RemoveConfirm: Remove {skill} from {ability}? Its level and analysis count will be lost.

AllowUntrainedSkillChecks.Name: Allow Untrained Skill Checks
AllowUntrainedSkillChecks.Hint: When disabled, players can't roll a skill they're untrained in.

tokenDisplayName.Name: Token Display Name
tokenDisplayName.Hint: Who can see a token's name. Applies to every actor and every token already on a scene, and to new ones.

tokenDisplayBars.Name: Token Resource Bars
tokenDisplayBars.Hint: Who can see a token's bars (bar 1 is Health). Applies to every actor and every token already on a scene, and to new ones.

InvisibleHidesToken.Name: Invisible Hides Tokens
InvisibleHidesToken.Hint: On: the Invisible status works like Foundry's own invisibility, and the token is hidden from anyone who can't see invisible creatures. Off: Invisible is only a status, and players find the creature with Spot / Listen against its Stealth. Changing this reloads the world.

ReduceSpiritVisionEffects.Name: Reduce Spirit Vision Effects
ReduceSpiritVisionEffects.Hint: Turns off the colours and glowing auras of Spirit Vision and Death Vision on this computer. Ghosts and other Ethereal creatures are still revealed. Use this if the canvas runs slowly. Changing this reloads Foundry.

Abilities.Empty: No abilities yet. Drag an ability from the Abilities compendium onto this sheet.

Learning.Title: Study {skill}
Learning.Current: Now {level}, {percent}% of the way to {next} through study.
Learning.ScheduleHint: Each day counts as at least 2 hours of new, useful lessons or research. Only one session a day counts.
Learning.SelfStudyHint: Learning alone, with no mentor, takes twice as long.
Learning.InspirationBoost: Inspiration {inspiration}: studies {steps} schedule(s) faster than chosen.
Learning.SequenceBoost: Sequence Knowledge and Training bonus: {steps} more schedule(s) faster for this skill.

TrainingBonus.Title: Knowledge and Training
TrainingBonus.Hint: Characters with this Sequence study these skills one schedule faster (1-2 days a week counts as 3-5, and so on).

Learning.PreviewProgress: These weeks bring it to {percent}% of the way to {next}.
Learning.AtMax: {skill} is already at the highest level.
Learning.NoLearningField: Learning progress can't be saved: this character has no 'learning' field. The system's base-actor.mjs is out of date.
Learning.ProgressTooltip: {percent}% of the way to {next} through study

Fast.Title: Learning by Doing
Fast.EnabledHint: This ability teaches skills through use. Characters with it get a ✋ button on the skills below to record each success. The next level needs 1 success to reach Trained, 2 for Proficient, 3 for Advanced, 4 for Mastery, and so on.
Fast.ConditionPlaceholder: e.g. A challenging, non-repetitive theft of something valuable to its owner
Fast.NotASkill: Only Skills can be added here.

EducationGrowth.Hint: Counts skills raised to these levels by study or Learning by Doing, not levels picked at creation or set by hand.

SkillAssociation.CategoriesHint: When a skill in a category reaches Advanced, the others in it go up one level (two at Mastery), but not above Proficient.
SkillAssociation.ModeHint: One-way links: "Only raises others" for Singing in Music, "Only raised by others" for Biology in Medical.
SkillAssociation.AllUsed: This skill is already in every category.

Drop.DigestionHint: How much of this Sequence's potion has been digested (1-20).
Drop.Unsupported: {name} can't be added to a character sheet.
Drop.SkillCompendiumOnly: {name} isn't from the Skills compendium, so it can't be added as a skill.
Drop.DragHintSkills: Skills are added by dragging them from the Skills compendium.
Drop.DragHintInventory: Items are added by dragging them onto the Inventory section.
Drop.SpellListEmpty: No spells in this list yet.
Drop.HiddenHint: Hidden on this NPC only. The Item that grants it isn't changed.
Drop.RestoreHint: Show this on the NPC again

Spirituality.InvalidAmount: Enter an amount of 1 or more.
Spirituality.NotEnough: {name} has only {value} Spirituality ({cost} needed). Nothing was spent.
Spirituality.ActionNotEnough: Not enough Spirituality ({value} of {cost}). It will roll without spending any.

NPC.Name: Name
NPC.SpiritAuraHint: Its aura colour in Spirit Vision: mood, nature. Leave empty and the colour shows its Health (gold to red).
NPC.UndeadHint: It glows brightly in Death Vision.
NPC.SequenceLineHint: The NPC's strongest Sequence. Add or remove Sequences on the Sequences tab.
NPC.AttributeTooltip: {name}: base {base}, Sequence {sequence}, other {other} (corruption, armor, Education growth)
NPC.SkillsEmpty: No skills yet. Drag skills here from the Skills compendium or the sidebar.

Inventory.StowedHint: Stowed / room in equipped clothing and bags
Inventory.DropHint: Drop gear on a coat or bag, or drop clothing and bags here
Inventory.NoContainers: No clothing or bags yet. Drop some here to get pockets.
Inventory.PocketsHint: Flavor only: the number of pockets doesn't change item slots.
Inventory.SkillUsedHint: Drop the skill this item's actions roll with (e.g. Pistol)
Inventory.NoSkill: None: its actions can't be rolled from the sheet

Armor.WornHint: Protects while Carried is set to Worn. Only one suit counts at a time.
Armor.FireHitsHint: Destroyed after {n} hits of fire damage.
Armor.ExpansionHint: One step per 10 effective damage. Each step lowers the critical-strike penalty against the gap by 2.

BreachLevels.penetrated: Penetrated: critical strikes here ignore armor
BreachLevels.broken: Broken: critical strikes here ignore armor, +1d6 damage

Warnings.Overloaded: Over the Strength limit by {slots}: Agility -{penalty}
Warnings.HiddenFull: More hidden than the hidden pockets hold.
Warnings.NoContainer: Not in any pocket or bag.
Warnings.MultipleClothing: More than one outfit is equipped.
Warnings.Suitcase: -2 to skill and ability checks while fighting with a suitcase
Warnings.SkillMissing: The skill on {name} no longer exists.
Warnings.TooWeakToWear: Not strong enough to wear this: gives no protection.
Warnings.ExtraArmor: Only one suit of armor counts, and it isn't this one.

Local.Name: Local Currency
Local.Hint: The currency the party is using right now. Item values are entered in gold pounds and shown in this currency; hover a price to see it in the others.

Fee.Name: Exchange Fee (%)
Fee.Hint: Taken whenever a character changes money from one currency to another. Moving money between purses and deposits is free.

Rate.intis: Exchange Rate: Verl d'or per Gold Pound
Rate.feysac: Exchange Rate: Gold Hoorn per Gold Pound

Settings.RateGuess: How many of this currency's main coin buy £1. The rulebook gives no rate, so the default is a placeholder: set it for your table.
Settings.RateWiki: How many of this currency's main coin buy £1. The default comes from the fan wiki ("1 Gold pound = 5.5 Gold hoorn"); the rulebook gives no rate.

Money.Title: Money
Money.StoredHint: Not on you: bank, safe, home.
Money.DepositsMissing: Not set up: the system's base-actor.mjs is out of date.
Money.NoPurse: No purse or wallet. Cash has to be carried in one: add a gear item and tick "Holds money".
Money.ValueHint: Price of one, in gold pounds: "£3 10s", "1 soli 2d", "8d", or just "5" for £5. £1 = 20 soli, 1 soli = 12 pence.
Money.IsPurseHint: Cash in a purse goes wherever the purse goes: a pickpocketed or looted wallet takes its money with it.
Money.AmountHint: Type amounts like "£2 5s 6d", "8d", "12 verl d'or 50 coppet". A plain number counts the main coin (5 = £5).

Errors.SamePlace: Pick two different places to move money between.
Errors.SameCurrency: Pick two different currencies to exchange.
Errors.TooSmall: That's too little to exchange: after the fee it's worth less than one coin.
Errors.NoDeposits: Deposits aren't set up on this character: the system's base-actor.mjs is out of date. Nothing was changed.

ActionSkill.Label: Skill
ActionSkill.Hint: Drop the skill this action rolls with (e.g. Pistol)
ActionSkill.None: None: this action can't be rolled from the character sheet
ActionSkill.Missing: The skill on {name} no longer exists.
ActionSkill.SpellDefault: None set: this spell rolls with Occultism
ActionSkill.SpellHint: Drop a skill to roll with it instead of Occultism

Action.Gone: That action or character no longer exists.
Action.BigSuccessHint: Roll damage as a Big Success (natural 20): never less than half the maximum damage, rounded up
Action.BigSuccessRaised: Big Success: rolled {rolled}, raised to half the maximum ({minimum})
Action.ApplyHint: Apply to the selected token(s) as one hit. Damage is lowered by each token's resistance and damage reduction (reduction never below 1); Shift-click to ignore them.
Action.SelectToken: Select one or more tokens first.
Action.NotOwner: You can't change {name}'s Health. Ask the GM to apply it.

DamageTaken.Title: {name} takes {amount} damage
DamageTaken.Ignored: Damage resistance and reduction were ignored.

Action.DamageTypesHint: Give parts their own type in brackets, like 2d6[fire] + 1d4[cold]. Parts without one use the Damage Type below.
Action.DCHint: A fixed DC for the roll (blank = none). The chat card says Success or Failure; the roll window can change it for one roll.

ActionGroups.FavoritesEmpty: Click the star next to an action's name to pin it here.

Firearm.IsFirearmHint: Holds rounds. Give it a Shoot action (Uses ammo: Fires rounds); its Reload, Unload and other buttons come with it (see Handling).
Firearm.CaliberHint: Only ammunition with the same caliber loads into it. Leave blank to take any ammunition.
Firearm.CapacityHint: Magazine: rounds it holds, not counting the chamber. Cylinder: chambers. Barrels: barrels.

Feed.Label: Feed
Feed.Hint: How it holds its rounds. Magazine: the last round loaded fires first (rifles, pistols, pump shotguns). Cylinder: the chamber under the hammer fires, then the cylinder turns (revolvers). Barrels: one round per barrel (break-action shotguns). Until one is chosen, a gun with a chamber is a magazine, one holding 1 or 2 rounds has barrels, and any other a cylinder. Unload it before changing this.

Firearm.HasChamberHint: Fires from a chamber that has to be loaded first (rack the slide, work the bolt, pump it).
Firearm.SelfLoadingHint: After a shot, the next round goes into the chamber by itself. Leave off for bolt and lever actions.
Firearm.Special: Special round: its spells go off when it's fired
Firearm.BoxTooltip: {boxes} boxes of {perBox}, {open} left in the open one
Firearm.IsAmmoHint: Rounds a firearm can be loaded with. The item's name is what the rounds are called once loaded.
Firearm.PerBoxHint: Quantity is the number of boxes. Set this to 1 for loose rounds.
Firearm.LoadAmountHint: Up to {n}. Load again to add a different kind.
Firearm.LoadChamberHint: Puts one round in the empty chamber, so it fires next.

LoadHint.magazine: The last round loaded is on top and fires first.
LoadHint.cylinder: Empty chambers are filled starting with the one under the hammer, so the first round loaded fires first.
LoadHint.barrels: Empty barrels are filled in order.

Firearm.RotateIntro: Which chamber goes under the hammer (fires next)?

Bullet.NotEnough: didn't go off: not enough Spirituality ({cost} needed)

Firearm.AmmoAmountHint: Rounds used each time (0 = 1; 2 fires both barrels).

AmmoUse.Label: Uses ammo
AmmoUse.Hint: Fires rounds: the attack uses up rounds from the gun this action comes from (or, if the character owns it directly, the gun they're holding). Its row also gets the gun's Reload, Unload and other buttons, set on the gun's sheet (Handling).
AmmoUse.OldHint: Reloading, chambering, rotating and unloading are now buttons on the gun's Shoot action, set on the gun's sheet (Handling). This action does nothing now: take it off the gun, or run the Retire Gun Actions macro.

Handling.Label: Handling
Handling.Hint: What can be done to it besides firing, and how long each takes. Each is a button on the gun's Shoot action; hovering over one shows its Action Type.
Handling.RoundsHint: The most one Reload loads (0 = as many as fit).
Handling.TooltipAllRounds: {name}: {type} action. Loads as many as fit.

Warnings.NoGun: No firearm to use. Hold one, or use the action listed under the gun.
Warnings.WhichGun: More than one firearm is held. Use the action listed under the gun you want.
Warnings.NotChambered: Click. {gun} has no round in the chamber.
Warnings.Click: Click. Chamber {n} of {gun} is empty; the cylinder turns to the next one.
Warnings.NothingToChamber: {gun} has no rounds left to chamber.

DamageReduction.Label: Damage Reduction
DamageReduction.Hint: Taken off each hit once, never below 1 damage. All: against every damage type.

DamageResistance.Label: Resistance / Immunity
DamageResistance.Hint: Takes that type's damage down, all the way to 0. Immune: that type does no damage.
DamageResistance.ImmuneHint: This damage type does no damage at all.

QuickDodge.Label: Quick Dodge
QuickDodge.Hint: Can dodge bullets: attacks that are too fast to dodge (firearms) still face full Physical Defense. Lightning and light still can't be dodged.

DefenseTargets.Label: Defense Targeted
DefenseTargets.Hint: Which defense of the targeted tokens the attack roll goes against. The chat card says Hit or Miss for each target.
DefenseTargets.gunDefault: Blank: firearm, too fast to dodge (10 + Armor, unless Quick Dodge)
DefenseTargets.physicalNoEvasion: Physical, too fast to dodge (firearms): 10 + Armor, unless Quick Dodge
DefenseTargets.physicalUndodgeable: Physical, can't be dodged (lightning, light): 10 + Armor

Attack.NoTargets: No targets: target tokens before rolling to check hits.
Attack.NoDefenseTarget: No Hit / Miss: {name} has no Defense Targeted. Set one on its sheet.
Attack.DefenseHint: The target's defense (only the GM sees this)

Sanity.Title: Sanity Check: {name}
Sanity.ButtonHint: Roll a sanity check. Shift-click: a 0/1 check straight away.
Sanity.Hint: Roll at or under your Sanity ({sanity}) to pass. Modifiers are added to the d20: a positive one makes failing likelier. A natural 20 is a Big Failure.
Sanity.InvalidLoss: A loss isn't a valid formula (use a number or dice, like 1d3).
Sanity.SolidifiedHint: Seen this kind of shock 3+ times: 1 less Sanity lost (never below 0). Not for promotions.
Sanity.BigFailure: Big Failure (natural 20): the most the loss can be
Sanity.RollLossHint: Roll the Sanity lost for this result and take it off. Burn Luck first if you're going to: it rolls for the result at that moment.
Sanity.BigFailureLoss: Big Failure (natural 20): the most the fail loss can be.
Sanity.AlreadyRolled: The loss for this check was already rolled.
Sanity.LossNotRolled: The loss hasn't been rolled yet: Roll Loss will use this result.

Luck.BurnHint: Spend Luck to add to or subtract from this roll. Natural 20s and 1s don't change.
Luck.NaturalHint: A natural 20 or natural 1 stays a Big Success or Big Failure.
Luck.NoBurners: No one here has Luck left to burn on this roll.
Luck.AdjustByHand: The result changed, but what the old result did can't be undone automatically. GM: adjust it by hand.

Promotion.Title: Promotion: {name}
Promotion.Hint: 1d20 + {base} + modifiers, at or under Sanity ({sanity}) to pass. No Big Success or Big Failure. Sanity lost: {success} on a pass, {failure} on a fail. Negative modifiers help.

Fields.digestion: Digestion of your current potion (-1 each)
Fields.isRepeated: Same Sequence as your current one (+40 instead of +20)
Fields.hasRitual: Promotion ritual held (5 sanity protection; without it, the loss is doubled)
Fields.isHelped: Helped by a Beyonder of your Sequence or higher (-2)
Fields.helperSequences: Sequences the helper is above you (-1 each)
Fields.followers: Followers (1 protection per 1,000; per 5,000 without a ritual)

Stages.promoted: {name} is promoted to {sequence}. Spiritual overflow for 72 hours: -2 on checks with the new abilities.
Stages.semi: {name} is semi-out-of-control, writhing in pain. Will check (DC 15): pass and the promotion succeeds; fail and lose more Sanity (1/1d2).
Stages.lost: {name} is losing control. Will check (DC 20): pass and become a Beyonder who failed to be promoted; fail and it's out of control or death (1d2).
Stages.failedPromotion: {name} holds on, but the promotion fails: a Beyonder in a special state (Expansion 5). The GM decides what that means.
Stages.pendingLoss: {name} drank the potion of {sequence}. Roll the Sanity it costs.
Stages.pendingExtraLoss: Roll the Sanity lost to this check.

Promotion.ExtraCheck: Sanity check {roll}: {result}. Loses 1 on a pass, 1d2 on a fail.
Promotion.ExtraLoss: Loses {loss} Sanity; {total} lost in this promotion.

Recovery.TreatedHint: The wounds were treated with a Medicine check: Long Rest heals Physique instead of half. Cleared by Long Rest.
Recovery.SanityMad: No Sanity back: Indeterminate Madness keeps sleep from restoring it.

OutcomeTables.Label: Outcome Tables
OutcomeTables.Hint: Roll Tables drawn after the roll, by its result against the DC (needs a DC). The chat card gets a Roll Outcome button.

Outcome.ButtonHint: Draw from the success or failure table, by the result now (burn Luck first if you're going to).
Outcome.AlreadyRolled: The outcome of this roll was already drawn.
Outcome.TableGone: That Roll Table no longer exists.

Enrichers.SanityHint: Sanity check for the selected token(s), or this character. Shift-click: roll straight away.
Enrichers.CheckHint: Roll for the selected token(s), or this character. Shift-click: roll straight away.
Enrichers.NoActor: Select a token you own, or set your character in User Configuration.
Enrichers.UnknownSkill: No skill named "{name}" in the Skills compendium or the sidebar.
